name: Hunter House

dates.altered: Enlarged after 1756 by Colonel Joseph Wanton Jr., 'adding a south wing and a second chimney, transforming the building into a formal Georgian mansion with a large central hall' (Wikipedia).

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 68000003; added November 24, 1968; designated NHL November 24, 1968; contributing to the Newport Historic District (ID68000001) (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
Hunter House | Newport Mansions
refs.note: The Preservation Society of Newport County, owner: 'Hunter House (c. 1748) is one of the finest examples of Colonial architecture in Newport.' Its page also records at least 13 enslaved people identified as living and working in the house.
